reviews.title: Software issues, solid hardware though

reviews.title: Long time Chromebook user loving this Googlebook.
reviews.body: I've used Chromebooks for over a decade. This is the nicest hardware I've ever seen. Google book OS has a few rough edges but it's getting better everyday. It already covers my Chromebook use cases with better phone connection and android app support.
